title: cd-rollouts
description: Argo Rollouts from its upstream chart. Strict at the top level: an upstream value written at the root of the file (controller: ... instead of argo-rollouts: controller: ...) is refused rather than silently ignored, because that mistake installs the defaults nobody chose. Open below: argo-rollouts is the upstream chart's own values, validated by the upstream chart.

argo-rollouts.description: The upstream chart's own values, verbatim.
